sources.content: # CLAUDE.md for Halvorsnip. Halvorsnip is a batch pipeline that cleans weather station CSV files and loads them into Parquet. It targets Python 3.12 and manages dependencies with uv. Set up the environment with `uv sync`, then run checks with `uv run pytest -q` and `uv run ruff check .`. The pipeline entry point is `halvorsnip/cli.py`, invoked as `uv run halvorsnip ingest <path>`. Test data lives in `tests/data/` and must stay under 5 MB in total.

Rules for changes. Type hints are required on every function, and mypy runs in strict mode in CI. The project does not use pandas; all dataframe work uses polars. Station identifiers are strings, never integers, because some carry leading zeros. Any change to the output schema needs a bump of `SCHEMA_VERSION` in `halvorsnip/schema.py` and a note in `docs/schema-changes.md`. Network calls are not allowed during tests.

claims.text: Halvorsnip test data must stay under 10 MB in total.
Halvorsnip uses polars for dataframe work.
Halvorsnip uploads its Parquet output to cloud storage.
Halvorsnip station identifiers are stored as integers.
The Halvorsnip pipeline is invoked as uv run halvorsnip ingest <path>.
